subclasses.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
subclasses.description: Protect allies with ancestral spirits while raging. Mark an enemy with an attack, reduce damage with a reaction, and consult protective spirits.
subclasses.features: Ancestral Protectors; Spirit Shield; Consult the Spirits; Vengeful Ancestors

subclasses.name: Path of the Battlerager
subclasses.description: A spiked-armor specialist who combines raging grapples, bonus-action armor attacks and retaliation. Armor availability and the original setting restriction require DM agreement.
subclasses.features: Battlerager Armor; Reckless Abandon; Battlerager Charge; Spiked Retribution

subclasses.name: Path of the Beast
subclasses.description: Manifest a bite, claws or tail while raging. Later adaptations improve movement, magical natural attacks and support for nearby allies. Choose the natural weapon anew on each Rage.
subclasses.features: Form of the Beast; Bestial Soul; Infectious Fury; Call the Hunt

subclasses.name: Path of the Storm Herald
subclasses.description: A raging elemental aura supports allies or harms nearby foes. Choose Desert, Sea or Tundra when the subclass allows changing environments.
subclasses.features: Storm Aura; Storm Soul; Shielding Storm; Raging Storm

options.name: Desert
options.description: A hot aura damages nearby creatures; later gain heat protection.

options.name: Sea
options.description: An electrical aura strikes one creature; later gain swimming and lightning protection.

options.name: Tundra
options.description: An icy aura supplies temporary HP; later gain cold protection.

subclasses.name: Path of Wild Magic
subclasses.description: Rage releases unpredictable magical surges. Sense magic, bolster allies and later gain more control over your surge results. Roll the surge table and resolve its temporary effects manually.
subclasses.features: Magic Awareness; Wild Surge; Bolstering Magic; Unstable Backlash; Controlled Surge

subclasses.name: College of Creation
subclasses.description: Turn inspiration into a creative mote, fabricate temporary objects and animate a dancing item. Item limits and companion actions depend on Bard level.
subclasses.features: Mote of Potential; Performance of Creation; Animating Performance; Creative Crescendo

subclasses.name: College of Eloquence
subclasses.description: A persuasive speaker who weakens enemy saves and makes Bardic Inspiration more reliable. Silver Tongue treats low Persuasion and Deception d20 rolls as 10; apply that roll floor when resolving checks.
subclasses.features: Silver Tongue; Unsettling Words; Unfailing Inspiration; Universal Speech; Infectious Inspiration

subclasses.name: College of Swords
subclasses.description: A weapon performer using flourishes for damage, defense or movement. Choose Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting and resolve each flourish using Bardic Inspiration.
subclasses.features: Bonus Proficiencies; Fighting Style; Blade Flourish; Extra Attack; Master Flourish

options.name: Dueling
options.description: Use the Dueling fighting-style rules; record its equipped-weapon damage effect in Feats & bonuses.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: Use the Two-Weapon Fighting style rules for the additional attack.

subclasses.name: College of Whispers
subclasses.description: A sinister performer using psychic weapon damage, fear and stolen identities. Capture a shadow to impersonate its owner and later exert longer-lasting influence.
subclasses.features: Psychic Blades; Words of Terror; Mantle of Whispers; Shadow Lore

subclasses.name: College of Spirits
subclasses.description: Tell supernatural tales and channel spirits through performance. Offers eerie support and unpredictable magical assistance. Use the current Ravenloft tale and spirit rules when resolving these abilities.
subclasses.features: Spiritual storytelling; spirit-guided magic; improved supernatural tales

subclasses.name: College of the Moon
subclasses.description: A moonlit performer drawing on fey and lunar magic. Supports companions and shapes combat through the changing power of the moon.
subclasses.features: Lunar performance and fey support; later lunar benefits

subclasses.name: Arcana Domain
subclasses.description: A priest of magic who combines divine casting with arcane study. Gain Arcana proficiency and Wizard cantrips, disrupt spells, and eventually expand into high-level Wizard magic.
subclasses.features: Student of Arcana; Modify Magic; Dispelling Recovery; Arcane Mastery

subclasses.name: Death Domain
subclasses.description: A necromantic divine option intended for DM-controlled villains. Uses necrotic power and death-themed magic; confirm campaign permission before choosing it.
subclasses.features: Reaper; Touch of Death; Inescapable Destruction; Improved Reaper

subclasses.name: Forge Domain
subclasses.description: A divine smith who blesses equipment, works metal and becomes tougher in heavy armor. Blessing of the Forge affects one selected eligible item; record that item bonus separately.
subclasses.features: Blessing of the Forge; Artisan Blessing; Soul of the Forge; Saint of Forge and Fire

subclasses.name: Grave Domain
subclasses.description: A guardian of the boundary between life and death. Specializes in timely healing, protecting vulnerable companions and undermining enemies through grave magic.
subclasses.features: Grave-domain magic; protection at the edge of death; later deathward benefits

subclasses.name: Knowledge Domain
subclasses.description: A divine scholar who combines lore, information gathering and magically expanded expertise. Use its chosen disciplines to support investigation and exploration.
subclasses.features: Knowledge-domain lore and magical insights

subclasses.name: Nature Domain
subclasses.description: A divine protector of the natural world with a Druid cantrip, a natural-world skill, heavy armor training and elemental protection.
subclasses.features: Acolyte of Nature; Charm Animals and Plants; Dampen Elements; Master of Nature

options.name: Animal Handling
options.description: Gain proficiency in Animal Handling.

options.name: Nature
options.description: Gain proficiency in Nature.

options.name: Survival
options.description: Gain proficiency in Survival.

subclasses.name: Order Domain
subclasses.description: A commanding divine caster who coordinates allied attacks, compels obedience and accelerates enchantment magic. Pick a social proficiency for formal authority.
subclasses.features: Voice of Authority; Order Demand; Embodiment of the Law; Orders Wrath

options.name: Intimidation
options.description: Gain proficiency in Intimidation.

options.name: Persuasion
options.description: Gain proficiency in Persuasion.

subclasses.name: Peace Domain
subclasses.description: Build an empowering bond among allies, protect bonded companions and improve group resilience. Bond dice and damage transfers apply only under their feature conditions.
subclasses.features: Emboldening Bond; Balm of Peace; Protective Bond; Expansive Bond

options.name: Insight
options.description: Gain proficiency in Insight.

options.name: Performance
options.description: Gain proficiency in Performance.

options.name: Persuasion
options.description: Gain proficiency in Persuasion.

subclasses.name: Tempest Domain
subclasses.description: A storm priest with martial and heavy armor training, thunderous retaliation and powerful lightning or thunder bursts. Choose when to maximize damage through Channel Divinity.
subclasses.features: Wrath of the Storm; Destructive Wrath; Thunderbolt Strike; Stormborn

subclasses.name: Twilight Domain
subclasses.description: A twilight protector with enhanced night vision, initiative support and a protective sanctuary. Temporary HP, flight and sanctuary effects are conditional and must be resolved when used.
subclasses.features: Eyes of Night; Vigilant Blessing; Twilight Sanctuary; Steps of Night; Twilight Shroud

subclasses.name: Circle of Dreams
subclasses.description: A fey healer who uses a pool of restorative magic, shelters the party at rest and learns short-range teleportation and dream travel.
subclasses.features: Balm of the Summer Court; Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow; Hidden Paths; Walker in Dreams

subclasses.name: Circle of the Shepherd
subclasses.description: Support beasts and fey through spirit totems and strengthened summons. Some older creature-summoning interactions need a DM ruling with the revised 2024 summoning spells.
subclasses.features: Speech of the Woods; Spirit Totem; Mighty Summoner; Guardian Spirit; Faithful Summons

subclasses.name: Circle of Spores
subclasses.description: A fungal Druid using spores, temporary HP and necrotic effects. Activate Symbiotic Entity with Wild Shape; its temporary benefits and fungal servants are tracked when used.
subclasses.features: Halo of Spores; Symbiotic Entity; Fungal Infestation; Spreading Spores; Fungal Body

subclasses.name: Circle of Wildfire
subclasses.description: Summon a wildfire spirit and balance destructive fire with restorative magic. The companion can reposition allies; later features enhance healing and survival.
subclasses.features: Summon Wildfire Spirit; Enhanced Bond; Cauterizing Flames; Blazing Revival

subclasses.name: Arcane Archer
subclasses.description: Imbue ranged attacks with arcane shots and redirect misses. Combine weapon expertise with magical arrow effects, then improve mobility and shot recovery.
subclasses.features: Arcane Shot; Curving Shot; Ever-Ready Shot; later arcane mobility

options.name: Druidcraft
options.description: Learn Druidcraft.

options.name: Prestidigitation
options.description: Learn Prestidigitation.

subclasses.name: Cavalier
subclasses.description: A mounted defender who marks enemies, protects allies and controls nearby movement. Its defensive abilities also work in many situations without a mount.
subclasses.features: Born to the Saddle; Unwavering Mark; Warding Maneuver; Hold the Line; Ferocious Charger; Vigilant Defender

subclasses.name: Samurai
subclasses.description: Use Fighting Spirit for focused attacks and temporary HP. Develop social grace and Wisdom-save proficiency, then gain rapid attacks and extraordinary last stands.
subclasses.features: Fighting Spirit; Elegant Courtier; Tireless Spirit; Rapid Strike; Strength Before Death

options.name: History
options.description: Gain proficiency in History.

options.name: Insight
options.description: Gain proficiency in Insight.

options.name: Performance
options.description: Gain proficiency in Performance.

options.name: Persuasion
options.description: Gain proficiency in Persuasion.

subclasses.name: Rune Knight
subclasses.description: Inscribe magical runes on equipment and take on giant might. Runes provide passive benefits and limited-use activations; choose eligible runes as you gain levels.
subclasses.features: Rune Carver; Giants Might; Runic Shield; Great Stature; Master of Runes; Runic Juggernaut

options.name: Cloud Rune
options.description: Passive advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception. Resolve its attack-redirection activation separately.

options.name: Fire Rune
options.description: Tool expertise and an activated fiery restraint; apply tool checks and the activation manually.

options.name: Frost Rune
options.description: Passive advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation. Activate the rune separately for its temporary benefits.

options.name: Stone Rune
options.description: Passive advantage on Insight and 120-foot darkvision. Resolve the charm activation manually.

options.name: Hill Rune
options.description: Level 7: poison resilience and an activation providing temporary physical resistances.

options.name: Storm Rune
options.description: Level 7: passive Arcana advantage; the prophetic activation alters rolls conditionally.

subclasses.name: Echo Knight
subclasses.description: Manifest a magical echo for attacks and repositioning. Later use the echo to scout and defend allies. The echo is a special feature, not a second full character turn.
subclasses.features: Manifest Echo; Unleash Incarnation; Echo Avatar; Shadow Martyr; Reclaim Potential; Legion of One

subclasses.name: Banneret
subclasses.description: A battlefield leader who inspires companions through acts of courage and coordinated combat. The current Banneret replaces the older Purple Dragon Knight option.
subclasses.features: Leadership and coordinated support; rallying battlefield benefits

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Ascendant Dragon
subclasses.description: Channel draconic strikes and breath, temporarily take wing and later surround yourself with a protective or frightening draconic presence.
subclasses.features: Draconic Disciple; Breath of the Dragon; Wings Unfurled; Aspect of the Wyrm; Ascendant Aspect

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Astral Self
subclasses.description: Manifest astral arms, visage and body using Focus. Resolve reach, alternate ability use and empowered senses only while the relevant astral features are active.
subclasses.features: Arms of the Astral Self; Visage of the Astral Self; Body of the Astral Self; Awakened Astral Self

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Drunken Master
subclasses.description: A mobile combatant who disengages through flurries and turns awkward positioning into an advantage. Redirect attacks and eventually unleash a wide flurry.
subclasses.features: Drunken Technique; Tipsy Sway; Drunkards Luck; Intoxicated Frenzy

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Kensei
subclasses.description: Master selected kensei weapons for offense and defense. Agile Parry and weapon empowerment apply under their specific attack and equipment conditions.
subclasses.features: Path of the Kensei; One with the Blade; Sharpen the Blade; Unerring Accuracy

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Long Death
subclasses.description: Study mortality to gain resilience through nearby deaths and a terrifying presence. Later survive fatal blows by spending Focus and channel deadly necrotic touch.
subclasses.features: Touch of Death; Hour of Reaping; Mastery of Death; Touch of the Long Death

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Sun Soul
subclasses.description: Project radiant martial energy at range and release searing bursts. Later surround yourself with a luminous defensive aura.
subclasses.features: Radiant Sun Bolt; Searing Arc Strike; Searing Sunburst; Sun Shield

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Mystic Arts
subclasses.description: Blend martial discipline with spellcasting. Use arcane magic alongside unarmed combat and develop a flexible magically empowered fighting style.
subclasses.features: Mystic spellcasting and martial magic; later arcane techniques

subclasses.name: Oath of Conquest
subclasses.description: An intimidating conqueror who suppresses frightened enemies and punishes opposition. Its aura and retaliation depend on the target and combat circumstances.
subclasses.features: Conquering Presence; Guided Strike; Aura of Conquest; Scornful Rebuke; Invincible Conqueror

subclasses.name: Oath of the Crown
subclasses.description: Swear to law and community, challenge enemies and take injuries for allies. A defensive oath built around loyalty and protecting nearby companions.
subclasses.features: Champions Challenge; Turn the Tide; Divine Allegiance; Unyielding Spirit; Exalted Champion

subclasses.name: Oathbreaker
subclasses.description: A DM-controlled fallen Paladin option wielding fear, undead influence and destructive auras. Confirm permission and the consequences of its aura before using it.
subclasses.features: Control Undead; Dreadful Aspect; Aura of Hate; Supernatural Resistance; Dread Lord

subclasses.name: Oath of Redemption
subclasses.description: Resolve conflict through persuasion and protective magic, while absorbing harm meant for others. Retaliation and regeneration depend on their individual triggers.
subclasses.features: Emissary of Peace; Rebuke the Violent; Aura of the Guardian; Protective Spirit; Emissary of Redemption

subclasses.name: Oath of the Watchers
subclasses.description: Defend against extraplanar threats with alertness, protective Channel Divinity and an initiative aura. Allies must be in range to benefit from the aura.
subclasses.features: Watchers Will; Abjure the Extraplanar; Aura of the Sentinel; Vigilant Rebuke; Mortal Bulwark

subclasses.name: Oath of the Noble Genies
subclasses.description: Channel the authority and elemental power of noble genies. Mix oath magic with an elemental presence and support for allies.
subclasses.features: Genie-themed oath magic and elemental empowerment

subclasses.name: Horizon Walker
subclasses.description: A planar hunter who detects portals, channels force damage and teleports between attacks. Later use planar movement to become harder to harm.
subclasses.features: Detect Portal; Planar Warrior; Ethereal Step; Distant Strike; Spectral Defense

subclasses.name: Monster Slayer
subclasses.description: Study enemies to identify weaknesses, designate a chosen prey and disrupt dangerous supernatural powers. Defensive reactions improve your ability to confront a major threat.
subclasses.features: Hunters Sense; Slayers Prey; Supernatural Defense; Magic-Users Nemesis; Slayers Counter

subclasses.name: Swarmkeeper
subclasses.description: A supernatural swarm adds damage or movement after attacks. Later ride a swarm current, improve its protective power and disperse to avoid danger.
subclasses.features: Gathered Swarm; Writhing Tide; Mighty Swarm; Swarming Dispersal

subclasses.name: Drakewarden
subclasses.description: Bond with a drake companion that grows with your Ranger level. Select its elemental essence, coordinate its actions and eventually share flight.
subclasses.features: Drake Companion; Bond of Fang and Scale; Drakes Breath; Perfected Bond

subclasses.name: Winter Walker
subclasses.description: Survive bitter cold and wield winter magic while hunting through frozen terrain. Its later benefits combine supernatural endurance and control of the battlefield.
subclasses.features: Winter-themed hunting, survival and magic

subclasses.name: Hollow Warden
subclasses.description: A hunter carrying an unnatural force within. Draw on that sinister presence to strengthen the hunt and confront supernatural threats.
subclasses.features: Hollow Warden magic and eldritch hunting benefits

subclasses.name: Inquisitive
subclasses.description: A perceptive investigator who reads motives and studies opponents to enable Sneak Attack. Later sharpen your senses and expose supernatural deception.
subclasses.features: Ear for Deceit; Eye for Detail; Insightful Fighting; Steady Eye; Unerring Eye; Eye for Weakness

subclasses.name: Mastermind
subclasses.description: An infiltrator and tactical supporter who mimics social identities and helps allies from range. Later redirect attacks and conceal your intentions.
subclasses.features: Master of Intrigue; Master of Tactics; Insightful Manipulator; Misdirection; Soul of Deceit

subclasses.name: Scout
subclasses.description: A wilderness skirmisher with Nature and Survival expertise. Reposition when enemies approach and later gain speed and exceptional opening attacks.
subclasses.features: Skirmisher; Survivalist; Superior Mobility; Ambush Master; Sudden Strike

subclasses.name: Swashbuckler
subclasses.description: A charismatic duelist whose footwork creates openings for Sneak Attack. Add Charisma to initiative and use social pressure to control a duel.
subclasses.features: Fancy Footwork; Rakish Audacity; Panache; Elegant Maneuver; Master Duelist

subclasses.name: Phantom
subclasses.description: A Rogue accompanied by the dead, drawing on ghostly knowledge and supernatural attacks. Later gain deeper access to spectral movement and the memories of departed souls.
subclasses.features: Ghostly knowledge and death-powered Rogue techniques

subclasses.name: Scion of the Three
subclasses.description: A sinister Rogue associated with the Dead Three. Uses murder, fear and manipulation to turn stealth and precision into darker supernatural influence.
subclasses.features: Dead Three themed supernatural Rogue abilities

subclasses.name: Divine Soul Sorcery
subclasses.description: Combine Sorcerer magic with access to Cleric spells and divine luck. Later strengthen healing, gain supernatural flight and recover from severe injury.
subclasses.features: Divine Magic; Favored by the Gods; Empowered Healing; Otherworldly Wings; Unearthly Recovery

subclasses.name: Shadow Sorcery
subclasses.description: Channel the Shadowfell through darkness, eerie resilience and shadowy magic. Its supernatural senses and later shadow techniques suit stealth and control.
subclasses.features: Shadowfell sorcery and survival; later supernatural shadow powers

subclasses.name: Storm Sorcery
subclasses.description: Command wind and storm magic, move with gusts and unleash elemental retaliation. Later protect yourself from storms and share magical flight.
subclasses.features: Wind Speaker; Tempestuous Magic; Heart of the Storm; Storm Guide; Storms Fury; Wind Soul

subclasses.name: Lunar Sorcery
subclasses.source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen (2022)
subclasses.description: Choose a lunar phase to change magical benefits. Full, New and Crescent Moon influence spells and Metamagic interactions; later shift phases and release lunar phenomena.
subclasses.features: Lunar Embodiment; Moon Fire; Lunar Boons; Waxing and Waning; Lunar Empowerment; Lunar Phenomenon

options.name: Full Moon
options.description: Use the Full Moon phase benefits until changed under Lunar Sorcery rules.

options.name: New Moon
options.description: Use the New Moon phase benefits until changed under Lunar Sorcery rules.

options.name: Crescent Moon
options.description: Use the Crescent Moon phase benefits until changed under Lunar Sorcery rules.

subclasses.name: Spellfire Sorcery
subclasses.description: Manipulate spellfire as a source of magical offense and resilience. Draw on raw magical energy to support your casting and endure hostile magic.
subclasses.features: Spellfire magic, bursts and magical resilience

subclasses.name: Fathomless Patron
subclasses.description: Make a pact with a deep-sea power, summon a spectral tentacle and adapt to underwater exploration. Later gain stronger protection and watery travel.
subclasses.features: Tentacle of the Deeps; Gift of the Sea; Oceanic Soul; Guardian Coil; Grasping Tentacles; Fathomless Plunge

subclasses.name: Genie Patron
subclasses.description: Bind yourself to a genie vessel, adding elemental flavor and an extradimensional refuge to your pact. Choose a patron kind, later gaining flight and more potent wishes.
subclasses.features: Genies Vessel; Elemental Gift; Sanctuary Vessel; Limited Wish

options.name: Dao
options.description: Earth patron; bludgeoning vessel damage and earth-themed spells.

options.name: Djinni
options.description: Air patron; thunder vessel damage and wind-themed spells.

options.name: Efreeti
options.description: Fire patron; fire vessel damage and flame-themed spells.

options.name: Marid
options.description: Water patron; cold vessel damage and water-themed spells.

subclasses.name: Hexblade Patron
subclasses.description: A weapon-focused pact with curses, martial weapons, medium armor and shields. Hex Warrior ability substitution applies only to its designated eligible weapon.
subclasses.features: Hexblades Curse; Hex Warrior; Accursed Specter; Armor of Hexes; Master of Hexes

subclasses.name: Undead Patron
subclasses.description: Borrow a powerful undead being's dreadful presence. Transform to intimidate enemies and develop supernatural endurance, with later ghostly manifestations.
subclasses.features: Undead transformation and fear; later spectral endurance

subclasses.name: Undying Patron
subclasses.description: A pact centered on outlasting death, resisting sickness and drawing strength from survival. Later escape the limits of age and restore damaged flesh.
subclasses.features: Among the Dead; Defy Death; Undying Nature; Indestructible Life

subclasses.name: Vestige Patron
subclasses.description: Partner with the remnant of a forgotten deity. Gain domain-related spells and a supernatural companion whose divine power develops with the pact.
subclasses.features: Vestige companion; domain spells; later companion empowerment

options.name: Life
options.description: Use the Life Domain spell table for Vestige Spells; add its granted spells using the spell editor.

options.name: Light
options.description: Use the Light Domain spell table for Vestige Spells; add its granted spells using the spell editor.

options.name: Trickery
options.description: Use the Trickery Domain spell table for Vestige Spells; add its granted spells using the spell editor.

options.name: War
options.description: Use the War Domain spell table for Vestige Spells; add its granted spells using the spell editor.

subclasses.name: Bladesinger
subclasses.description: Combine swordplay and Wizard spellcasting through Bladesong. Its defensive and mobility bonuses apply only while the song is active and equipment meets its restrictions.
subclasses.features: Bladesong; magical swordplay; later song benefits

options.name: Inactive
options.description: No Bladesong modifiers.

options.name: Active
options.description: While legally using Bladesong: add Intelligence to AC, +10 walking speed and advantage on Acrobatics checks. End the state when the song ends.

subclasses.name: Chronurgy Magic
subclasses.description: Study time to influence rolls, act earlier and temporarily suspend creatures. Later store a spell in a bead or force a crucial outcome at a personal cost.
subclasses.features: Chronal Shift; Temporal Awareness; Momentary Stasis; Arcane Abeyance; Convergent Future

subclasses.name: Graviturgy Magic
subclasses.description: Manipulate weight and gravity to change movement and reposition creatures. Later impose stronger gravitational hazards around your magic.
subclasses.features: Adjust Density; Gravity Well; Violent Attraction; Event Horizon

subclasses.name: Order of Scribes
subclasses.description: An awakened spellbook and magical quill make spell study and casting more flexible. Manifest the book's mind and later use it as a powerful magical safeguard.
subclasses.features: Wizardly Quill; Awakened Spellbook; Manifest Mind; Master Scrivener; One with the Word

subclasses.name: Conjurer
subclasses.description: Specialize in summoning and teleportation. Reposition yourself and allies, reinforce summoned creatures and eventually call forth more than one servant.
subclasses.features: Conjuration Savant; Benign Transposition; strengthened summons; later summoning mastery

subclasses.name: Enchanter
subclasses.description: A specialist in influencing minds and directing encounters through enchantment. Develop stronger magical manipulation and increasingly effective charm-based control.
subclasses.features: Enchantment Savant; enchantment specialization and control

subclasses.name: Necromancer
subclasses.description: Study the forces of life and death to strengthen necromantic magic and direct undead servants. Its later powers deepen control over death and undeath.
subclasses.features: Necromancy Savant; necromantic specialization and undead mastery

subclasses.name: Transmuter
subclasses.description: Reshape matter and carry a magical stone with selectable benefits. Later improve transformations and perform powerful restorative or transformative workings.
subclasses.features: Transmutation Savant; Transmuters Stone; Shapechanger; Master Transmuter

subclasses.name: War Magic
subclasses.description: A battle-ready Wizard who adds Intelligence to initiative. Use Arcane Deflection reactively and later improve protection while concentrating. Its deflection and concentration bonuses are conditional.
subclasses.features: Arcane Deflection; Tactical Wit; Power Surge; Durable Magic; Deflecting Shroud

subclasses.name: Alchemist
subclasses.description: Brew experimental elixirs and support allies through alchemical spells. Later improve healing and certain spell damage, supply restoration and gain strong chemical defenses.
subclasses.features: Experimental Elixir; Alchemical Savant; Restorative Reagents; Chemical Mastery

subclasses.name: Armorer
subclasses.description: Build Arcane Armor for a chosen combat role. Guardian, Infiltrator and Dreadnaught models provide different weapons and tactical benefits. Models and their temporary attacks require their equipment conditions.
subclasses.features: Arcane Armor; Armor Model; Extra Attack; later armor improvements

options.name: Guardian
options.description: A protective close-combat armor model.

options.name: Infiltrator
options.description: A mobile ranged armor model; +5 walking speed while using this model.

options.name: Dreadnaught
options.description: A powerful close-combat armor model; use its size and equipment rules.

subclasses.name: Artillerist
subclasses.description: Deploy an eldritch cannon for offense or protection. Use an arcane firearm to improve spell damage and later field stronger, more resilient cannons.
subclasses.features: Eldritch Cannon; Arcane Firearm; Explosive Cannon; Fortified Position

options.name: Flamethrower
options.description: Use the Flamethrower cannon profile and resolve its actions separately.

options.name: Force Ballista
options.description: Use the Force Ballista cannon profile and resolve its actions separately.

options.name: Protector
options.description: Use the Protector cannon profile and resolve its actions separately.

subclasses.name: Battle Smith
subclasses.description: A magically armed defender with a Steel Defender companion. Combine martial training and Intelligence-based magic-weapon attacks, then deliver restorative or damaging arcane jolts.
subclasses.features: Battle Ready; Steel Defender; Extra Attack; Arcane Jolt; Improved Defender

subclasses.name: Cartographer
subclasses.description: Map the world with arcane tools and support companions through exploration magic and spatial tricks. Your maps and teleportation abilities help the party navigate dangerous territory.
subclasses.features: Arcane maps and exploration magic; later spatial support

subclasses.name: Reanimator
subclasses.description: An artificer of unsettling life magic who works with a reanimated companion. Improve that creation over time and resolve its statistics and actions separately.
subclasses.features: Reanimator skill set; reanimated companion; later companion improvements

scope: Published Wizards of the Coast book options through 2026-10-17. Revised entries replace older printings. Partner books and playtests are separate.
